prompt: A photorealistic, high-resolution image of a bustling outdoor technology expo in Tokyo. The scene is dominated by three massive humanoid robots standing on a paved plaza. The central robot is the largest, featuring a complex black and white armored exoskeleton with red flashing lights on its shoulders and a multi-lens sensor array for a head. It has "警視庁 MPD" (Metropolitan Police Department) written in white text on its chest plates. To its left stands a similar but slightly smaller blue and white robot, and to its right is a red and black robot. In the foreground, several police officers wearing dark uniforms with "警視庁 MPD" on their backs are walking among crowds of civilians taking photos with smartphones. Smaller quadruped robots and service bots are scattered near the bottom edge. Blue banners reading "ROBOT EXPO TOKYO" hang from metal scaffolding structures. The background features a bright blue sky, a body of water, and the skyline of modern skyscrapers.

promptZh: 一张逼真的高分辨率图片，描绘了东京一个热闹的户外科技博览会场景。画面主体是三个巨大的类人机器人，矗立在铺砌的广场上。中间的机器人最大，拥有复杂的黑白装甲外骨骼，肩部闪烁着红色警示灯，头部配备多镜头传感器阵列。其胸甲上印有白色文字“警视厅 MPD”（东京都警察本部）。左侧是一个类似但稍小的蓝白相间机器人，右侧则是一个红黑配色的机器人。前景中，几名身穿深色制服、背部印有“警视厅 MPD”字样的警察正在人群中穿行，周围有许多市民正用手机拍照。底部边缘附近散布着一些小型四足机器人和服务型机器人。金属脚手架结构上悬挂着写有“ROBOT EXPO TOKYO”的蓝色横幅。背景是晴朗的蓝天、一片水域以及现代摩天大楼的天际线。
